My Love(Westlife)-Peak & Pitch Ver.

"An empty street, an empty house, a hole inside my heart."

Sometimes, growing up feels like learning how to sit with the quiet.
Even in our busy lives, there are late-night moments when the silence gets a little too loud, and memories start rushing in.

We all have that one person, or perhaps a past version of ourselves, we miss so deeply. 
We sang Westlife’s beautiful classic, 'My Love,' to capture that exact feeling of longing and connection.

Close your eyes, listen to the harmonies, and let yourself miss whoever is on your mind today. 
It’s okay to hold on for a little while. 🌙✨

snippet.title: To you, who swam through the heavy waves of life today. 🌊#shorts
snippet.description:
To you, who swam through the heavy waves of life today. 🌊

SWIM(BTS)-Peak & Pitch Ver.

Life in your often feels like treading water in an endless ocean, doesn't it?
The pressure to keep up, the currents of uncertainty pulling us in every direction, 
and those days when just staying afloat takes everything you have. We get it.

We arranged this cover of 'SWIM' to be your little life raft for the night. 
No heavy beats, no rushing—just an acoustic guitar, our voices, and a moment for you to finally catch your breath.

"To you, who bravely swam through life today—you’ve worked so hard." 💜

Whether you’re drowning in deadlines, struggling with growing up, or just feeling utterly exhausted, 
we hope our harmony gives you a quiet place to rest. 
You don't have to fight the waves tonight. Let the water carry you, close your eyes, and just float for a while.

#Peakandpitch #bts #swim #chillvibes #cover

snippet.title: Stepping out & Spreading vibes ☀️#shorts #cover #peakandpitch

Stepping out & Spreading vibes ☀️

Happy(Pharrell Williams)-Peak & Pitch Ver.

Some days the weather is just too good, the fit is on point, 
and you just can't help but groove down the street. 🌤️👟

For this cover, we took Pharrell Williams' ultimate feel-good anthem "Happy" 
out of the studio and into the neighborhood. 
No fancy lights, no stages—just pure energy, fresh air, and us catching the rhythm of the city. 
We wanted to capture that carefree vibe where you just let go and 
enjoy the moment, regardless of who's watching.

Whether you're stuck on a morning commute, pulling an all-nighter for finals, 
or just chilling with your iced Americano at a local cafe, 
we hope our voices and this spontaneous street jam bring a little sunshine to your screen today.

snippet.title: For the ones we still look for in the crowd🎧 #shorts
snippet.description:
For the ones we still look for in the crowd

My Love(Westlife)-Peak & Pitch Ver.

"An empty street, an empty house, a hole inside my heart."

Sometimes, growing up feels like learning how to sit with the quiet.
Even in our busy lives, there are late-night moments when the silence gets a little too loud, and memories start rushing in.

We all have that one person, or perhaps a past version of ourselves, we miss so deeply. 
We sang Westlife’s beautiful classic, 'My Love,' to capture that exact feeling of longing and connection.

Close your eyes, listen to the harmonies, and let yourself miss whoever is on your mind today. 
It’s okay to hold on for a little while. 🌙✨

To you, who swam through the heavy waves of life today. 🌊

SWIM(BTS)-Peak & Pitch Ver.

Life in your often feels like treading water in an endless ocean, doesn't it?
The pressure to keep up, the currents of uncertainty pulling us in every direction, 
and those days when just staying afloat takes everything you have. We get it.

We arranged this cover of 'SWIM' to be your little life raft for the night.
